_provenance.status: tuned -- RECONSTRUCTED from tune_<task>.csv, not written by the tuner
_provenance.reconstruction: The tuner completed both searches (233 configs x 2 tasks, all 6 stages, CSVs intact) and then died after the search and before writing this file; cause not determined, stderr was lost with the launching shell. These configs are read from the STAGE 6/6 confirmation rows, which are the settled point re-scored as a unit -- they are labelled "DEFAULT (inherited)" only because that stage searches no axis (tune_config.py:166,177), and they do not match the pinned inherited reference at tune_config.py:77.
_provenance.selection_metric_caveat: Ranked on lofo_r2 / lofo_prauc, discounted by NOISE_CEILING per doubling of fit cost. Those are the pooled metrics aug-01.md T1.2b retires. Valid for ranking the 27 arms against each other (paired, shared config); NOT a config to ship.
_provenance.sanity_note: Narrow-arm check run separately on 2026-08-01 after the tuner crashed before writing this file: `--task both --sanity-only` (no --write, which would have overwritten search_minutes with the 2-minute sanity run). Neither task loses more than one noise floor on the island arm at the shared config; both deltas are positive, i.e. the settled config is marginally BETTER on the narrow arm than the provisional one it replaces, at 2.3-2.4x fewer trees.
